h:
朋友们大家好，
我创建了 3 个自定义节点来自动下载 'Kijai/WanVideo_comfy' 、 'alibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-Control' 、 'Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged' 中的所有模型

链接到自定义节点 -https://github.com/AIExplorer25/ComfyUI_AutoDownloadModels

只需克隆您的“/workspace/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/”文件夹并 pip 安装要求。

节点名称：

1“从 Kijai 的存储库自动下载所有 WAN 模型”

2：“从 Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged 自动下载所有 WAN 模型”

3：“从alibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-Control自动下载所有WAN模型”

这对于您下载 WAN 的所有模型非常有帮助，您可以选择要下载的模型并运行工作流程，它将在相应的文件夹中为您下载模型，将默认文件夹视为“/workspace/ComfyUI/models/”

o.en:
Hello Friends,
I have created 3 custom nodes to auto download all models from 'Kijai/WanVideo_comfy' , 'alibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-Control' , 'Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged'

Link to custom node -https://github.com/AIExplorer25/ComfyUI_AutoDownloadModels

just clone inside your '/workspace/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/' folder and pip install the requirements.

Node Names:

1 "Auto Download ALL WAN Models from Kijai's repo"

2: "Auto Download ALL WAN Models from Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged"

3:"Auto Download ALL WAN Models fromalibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-Control"

This would be super helpful for you to download all models for WAN , you can select which one you want to download and run the workflow, it will download the model for you on respective folders, considering default folder as '/workspace/ComfyUI/models/'
